decisions.reason: Conferencing is a peripheral, low-investment add-on that crowded collaboration markets have made less attractive since 2020, but keeping it in the broad portfolio costs little and it has not yet clearly failed.
The metro data centre network rests on sunk fibre investment, has publicly reported adoption and is central to the announced data centre and cloud direction, so commitment remains strong.
Optical spectrum connectivity uses owned fibre, fits the high-bandwidth strategy and was showcased on its own page, which reinforces continued commitment.
The number ordering portal is a cheap-to-run software platform that supports the real-time provisioning direction, so it stays.

Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy service with little strategic centrality, but its low running costs and regulatory ties let the firm attribute weak demand to market transition and keep it a while longer.
Direct voice network connection builds on the established voice infrastructure serving enterprise customers, so the firm persists with it.
